name: Scriben API
description:
The Scriben API gives programmatic access to what Scriben recorded and understood: notes, summaries, action items, transcript passages and durable memory.

Every endpoint reads except two, each behind a scope chosen when the key is created: `POST /v1/imports/{source}` brings history in, and `POST /v1/notes/{ref}/share` publishes one note as a page. Every response is scoped to the account that owns the API key — no endpoint accepts an account identifier as an argument.
